description: A React component story file for the NumberFormat validator in the superset-ui-core package, providing a UI to test number formatting with various inputs and formats.

classes.name: NumberFormatValidator
classes.description: A React PureComponent that provides a UI for entering a D3 format string and displaying formatted test values.

methods.name: handleFormatChange
methods.description: Updates the format string in the component state based on user input.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the UI including input for format string and table of formatted test values.
